mapper.sql: csa.id AS id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(egroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM egroups WHERE egroups.id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM crm_support_activity_egroups WHERE crm_support_activity_id = csa.id ) ) AS employeeGroupName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM crm_support_stags WHERE crm_support_stags.id IN ( SELECT crm_support_stag_id FROM crm_support_stag_activities WHERE crm_support_activity_id = csa.id ) ) AS stageName, csa.name AS activityName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM crm_support_tasks WHERE crm_support_activity_id = csa.id AND is_active = 1 ) AS taskName, csa.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, csa.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM crm_support_activities AS csa LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = csa.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = csa.modified_by

WHERE csa.is_active = 1
AND csa.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_support_activities SET is_active = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM crm_support_tasks WHERE crm_support_activity_id = #{activityId} AND is_active = 1
